title: Can You Get Sunburnt on a Cloudy Day?
description: Invisible sun rays sneak through clouds, so here is how to stay safe.
narration: Can you really get sunburnt on a cloudy day? Yes, because sunlight carries invisible rays that can harm your skin. Our air blocks some kinds, but UVA slips through much more easily. The higher the Sun climbs, the stronger these rays get. Clouds and cool weather will not stop them. They also bounce off water, sand and snow. So smear on a sunscreen that blocks both UVA and UVB.
